description: Use when an agent must put a list in an order nobody can claim was arranged: a uniformly random shuffle with Fisher-Yates over the platform CSPRNG, so every permutation is equally likely, which sorting by a random key does not give you. Do not use to take just one or a few items (/v1/random/pick). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

items.description: The list to shuffle, comma-separated. A JSON array of strings is also accepted in a POST body.

name: random_shuffle
title: Shuffle a list
